channel.title: My first SCP article
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "My first SCP article" - I have so many ideas, but which should I pitch first?

item.title: Re: My first SCP article
item.content:encoded:
Okay maybe you need a history lesson. The term "Scapegoat" actually comes from the Bible, and this is real, you can look it up, Leviticus Chapter 16. In addition to the Ten Commandments given in the book of Exodus, the book of Leviticus lists a number of other laws for the nation of Israel and if a Jew breaks any one of those laws, that is a sin. The list is so exhaustive it's pretty much impossible for anyone to go long without committing one sin so they had a ritual to cleanse people of their sins by confessing to the High Priests from the line of Aaron and once a year they in turn would recite these sins over the head of a goat which they then allowed to escape into the wilderness of the desert and take those sins with them to the angel Azazel. Yes, this is a legit thing, and we still use that word to this day because of this ancient tradition.

So anyway, I figure if you put all the sins of an entire nation for a year on one poor little goat, that may have a sinister effect and maybe there's a herd of a few thousand immortal demon goats somewhere in the desert of Israel. It's actually an idea I had for a long time before I even came to this wiki. Actually all of them are, except that last SPC, but these ones I listed are ideas I had with no context and the SCP format looks like a good place to share them, just give you all an idea of what they are and what we're doing to keep them from killing us. Scapegoats and Swine Legion would actually fit well in the Competitive Eschatology Canon.

item.title: Re: My first SCP article
item.content:encoded:
You should pick the idea that you're most excited about, frankly — or at least, most easily able to translate your excitement into words to aid the greenlight process.

Scapegoats - the cursed goats that carry the sins of the nation of Israel according to an ancient ritual.

Question, though, what are the "sins of the nation of Israel"?

item.title: My first SCP article
item.content:encoded:
I am new and I have been thinking of a few ideas for SCP articles, but now that I have my big shot I don't which one you guys want to see first, so before I head in for the greenlight, does anyone wanna weigh in on which one you want to read that I should pitch first?

Playing with Fire - silly putty like substance that is plasma at room temperature, from Dr. Wondertainment.
Vampire Bodega - mini-mart where everything seems to be free, but actually draws blood from customers, not noticeable unless the customer comes more than twice a week. May be part of Marshall, Carter and Dark.
Cryovampire - cryogenically preserved person who was successfully revived, but now absorbs heat energy. Must be kept in a room heated to 98.6 degrees Farenheit at which point the ambient temperature neutralizes the anomaly, but as soon as it is exposed to lower temperatures it reverts to a savage that freezes anything it touches.
Alzoidian - a cephalopod like alien life form native to the red spot of Jupiter. Exists in symbiosis with a fungus and another species that resembles a manta ray. Still not quite sure how to explain how the foundation even acquired it…
Scapegoats - the cursed goats that carry the sins of the nation of Israel according to an ancient ritual.
Swine Legion - the cursed swine possessed by demons exorcised by Jesus.

SPC-2806: cybernetics for pugilists who lost limbs in shark attacks so that they may once again punch sharks.
